description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mattegoda, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520008
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 20, Block 20) with detailed land particulars including owner information, extent, nature of title, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically dealing with land registrations and title determinations.
